_about: Spanish for both iPhone apps. Edit this file, then run node scripts/build-ios-strings.mjs to rebuild the String Catalogs. Neutral Latin American Spanish, tu form. Server text (statuses, prices, catalog names, notifications) stays English. Keys are the English phrase as iOS looks it up: %@ text, %lld whole number, %% a percent sign.

keepEnglish.I have read the Independent Contractor A: Signature on the English contract (assembler/contractor-agreement.html, a critical module). A Spanish version needs General Counsel and the owner.
keepEnglish.I agree to the AssembleAtEase Code of Co: Signature on the English Code of Conduct and Terms; same reason.
